resources.string: Your apps, your watch, your way
You get the official apps yourself; nothing is bundled here.
The patches let Samsung Health Monitor work on a phone that is not made by Samsung, and the patched watch app installs next to the stock one.
Every change can be undone, and the original apps are never uninstalled.
What will change on my devices?

In unattended mode LibreWrist does over ADB everything that can be automated (installing, granting permissions, turning options on) on the phone and on the watch, and it does not go on without an ADB connection to both. Between steps it waits a few seconds (5 by default, adjustable in Settings): if you touch or scroll the screen while the bar on the button is filling, it pauses and you continue by hand; the following steps go on by themselves again.
How long the bar on the button takes to fill before the step continues by itself. It does not apply while Advance freely is on.
It will not stop at operation confirmations (correcting the profile, notices) until it reaches the end or something fails.

If an app on the phone or the watch is signed with another key, LibreWrist uninstalls it without asking and all its data is lost (for example, the measurements saved in that app). That is the only way to install the patched copy. This cannot be undone.
LibreWrist will not stop at operation confirmations (correcting the profile, notices) until it reaches the end or something fails. You can turn this off at any time from this screen.

Unattended mode can only run from start to finish once you have downloaded the apps to patch. LibreWrist does not download them by itself: in the “Bring the official apps” step you get each one or pick a file you already have. If you don\'t have the APKs yet, or the list of apps changes (for example, with a new version), unattended mode stops at that step until you download them, and then goes on by itself.
Every app that gets installed, what it is for and what it is allowed to do. Nothing is erased without asking you first, and all of it can be undone.
It stays on the watch and can be turned back on at any time.

How to tell which version I have
Which version does my watch have?
On the watch, swipe down from the top of the watch face and tap the gear to open **Settings**.
Scroll to the bottom of **Settings** and tap **About watch**.
Look at Wear OS version or Android version. Wear OS 5 or newer, One UI 6 Watch or newer, or Android 14 or newer means the first option; anything older, the second.

The same screen is in the Galaxy Wearable app on the phone: **Watch settings** › **About watch** › **Software information**.
Galaxy Watch7, Watch Ultra and newer always qualify. Watch4, Watch5, Watch6 and Watch FE qualify only once updated to One UI 6 Watch.
Not sure? Pick either: the app checks your watch itself once it is connected (step 3) and corrects the choice before anything is downloaded.
